title.narrative: We embroider in community: textile art in Oaxaca

description.narrative: This project seeks to improve the link between textile art and the social, economic, environmental and cultural conditions of the communities where the women, families, and artisan cooperatives of the communities of Oaxaca live. All this is achieved through training in the formulation of local business models and financial education, as well as the establishment of dialogues for intercultural planning that favors the safeguarding of heritage and the development of cultural expressions, with a gender focus and the implementation of specific indicators that contribute to the systematization and replication of the experience. The project is planned to be carried out in the Isthmus of Tehuantepec region, in the state of Oaxaca, in one of these two municipalities, to be defined according to the criteria of UNESCO, the Banorte Foundation and the state of Oaxaca: San Blas Atempa or Santo Domingo Tehuantepec
